# dlg (Decision Ledger)

> Single-binary, local-first ledger of engineering decisions made with several AI agents. A primary agent analyses, reviewers challenge, the user decides. No model code; it pipes text to and from the agents you already use.

Full agent guide: AGENTS.md. Human docs: README.md.

## Commands (all inside a project with .decision-ledger/)

- `dlg problems [--json]`: list problems
- `dlg status [id] [--json]`: state, reviewers waiting, new replies; JSON also includes unanswered_questions
- `dlg cost [id] [--json]`: reported cost and token usage for supported Claude/Cursor/Codex commands; unknown cost is not estimated
- `dlg models [--refresh] [--json]`: available model presets
- `dlg analyse <id> [--model KEY]`: run one primary analysis round
- `dlg handoff <id> <to> [--json] [--peek]`: print the text a reviewer should answer
- `dlg review <id> <author> [--file F]`: store a reply (stdin), warnings on stderr
- `dlg note <id> [text]`: add a note
- `dlg parse <review-id> [--json]`: per-point positions of a stored reply
- `dlg run <id> <agent>`: opt-in; pipe the handoff to the agent's configured command and store its stdout as a review
- `dlg config show | set-runner <agent> <command> | unset-runner <agent>`: runner setup (command line only)
- `dlg config --global use <tool>` / `set-runner <identity> <command>`: reusable defaults, configured and approved by the user in a terminal
- `dlg config approve-runners`: user approves inherited reviewer commands in the current project
- `dlg config codex-folder <git|plain>`: user chooses whether standard read-only Codex analysis requires Git in this project
- `dlg mcp`: MCP stdio server with the same operations (dlg_problems, dlg_status, dlg_handoff, dlg_review, dlg_note, dlg_parse)
- `dlg serve`: local UI and HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:8765 (writes need header `X-Ledger: 1`)

## Reply format

```
SUMMARY: your view in 2-3 lines
SOLUTION: the approach you recommend
[P1] AGREE | DISAGREE: why   (one line per point for review)
NEW: points missed (optional)
OPEN: questions (optional)
```

## Recipes

- CLI agent: `dlg handoff 3 claude | claude -p | dlg review 3 claude`
- IDE agent: MCP server `{"command":"dlg","args":["mcp"]}`
- Script: `GET /api/problems/{id}/handoffs/{to}`, `POST /api/problems/{id}/reviews {"author","body"}`
- Chat-only model: `dlg handoff 3 gemini | pbcopy`, paste the answer back with `dlg review`

## Limits

Agents never select, approve or resolve; only the user does.
Agent commands and workdir are configured by the user, not by agents or HTTP.
The guided UI requires explicit primary setup; reviewers are optional.
See README.md for the current Codex implementation-command compatibility note.

The UI preserves browser drafts across restarts, distinguishes drafts from saved/included input,
and recommends the next action without deciding for the user. Activity can compare two saved
analysis rounds. Workspace tabs support arrows/Home/End and preserve field focus on refresh.
Browser drafts are local to the browser profile and server origin, not ledger exports.
Users can explicitly reuse a saved answer as a point ruling; agents must not create
those links themselves. A model-generated decided status alone never settles a point.
Next-step guidance is also shown on Reviews after automatic rounds.
Final proposals render as Markdown in a compact card and reading dialog. Copy Markdown
preserves the original; settled-point badges come from ledger state. Rendering is local,
with raw HTML and image loading disabled.
A newer final proposal that differs from the approved selection is flagged in the UI
and in full problem detail as approval_change. Implementation keeps using the approved
selection until the user explicitly selects and approves a replacement.
